name: BMP580 pressure & temperature sensor
description: Bosch low-cost barometric pressure (30–125 kPa, ±6 Pa relative, ±30 Pa absolute) and temperature (-40 to +85 °C, ±0.5 °C) sensor with on-chip compensation (no calibration maths), I2C/I3C and SPI. The chip runs on 1.71–3.6 V. Sold as: Adafruit BMP580 I2C or SPI Temperature and Pressure Sensor - STEMMA QT (#6411), 8-pin header VIN, 3Vo, GND, SCL, SDO, SDA, CS, INT (3.3 V regulator and level shifting, 3–5 V supply, two STEMMA QT sockets), I2C address 0x47 (0x46 with SDO to GND or the addr jumper closed).
eli5: A barometer and thermometer on a chip: it notices the air pressure change when you carry it up a flight of stairs, and reports the temperature too.

pins.name: VIN
pins.description: Supply, 3–5 V into the on-board 3.3 V regulator (use the same voltage as your board's logic)

pins.name: 3Vo
pins.description: 3.3 V output of the on-board regulator (up to 100 mA); not a supply input, leave unconnected

pins.name: SCL
pins.description: I2C clock (SPI SCK); pull-up and level shifting on the board, 3–5 V logic

pins.name: SDO
pins.description: I2C address select (SPI data out, 3.3 V): open = 0x47, GND = 0x46. Leave unconnected for the default address

pins.name: SDA
pins.description: I2C data (SPI SDI); pull-up and level shifting on the board, 3–5 V logic

pins.name: CS
pins.description: SPI chip select (active low); pulled up on the board so the chip uses I2C. Leave unconnected for I2C

pins.name: INT
pins.description: Interrupt output (3.3 V, data ready / FIFO / out-of-range), not needed for basic use

buildNotes: Power VIN with the same voltage as your board's logic (3.3 V on ESP32/Pico). 3Vo is an output: never feed it.
The default I2C address is 0x47. Tie SDO to GND or close the addr jumper on the back for 0x46, e.g. for a second sensor.
Check the chip ID: register 0x01 reads 0x50 on a BMP580 (same as the BMP581; 0x51 on a BMP585).
After a soft reset (0xB6 to 0x7E) the chip sits in deep standby: write ODR_CONFIG (0x37) with deep_dis set and pwr_mode 00, wait 2.5 ms, configure, then trigger forced mode (pwr_mode 10).
Results are already compensated: temperature = signed 24-bit at 0x1D–0x1F / 65536 °C, pressure = 24-bit at 0x20–0x22 / 64 Pa, both LSB first. Read all 6 bytes in one burst.
Pressure is only measured when press_en (OSR_CONFIG 0x36 bit 6) is set; otherwise only temperature updates.
Keep it out of drafts and away from warm parts: airflow shows up as pressure noise.

driver.code:
# MicroPython driver for the Bosch BMP580 pressure/temperature sensor (I2C)
# Written from Bosch datasheet BST-BMP580-DS004-02 (rev 1.2):
#   post-power-up checks sec. 4.3.9, soft reset 4.3.10, forced mode 4.3.3/4.3.7,
#   data format 4.5 (T = raw/2^16 degC, p = raw/2^6 Pa), register map sec. 7,
#   timings table 4 (t_powup 2 ms, t_soft_res 2 ms, t_standby 2.5 ms, t_conv_p / t_conv_t).
# The BMP580 is factory-compensated: no calibration coefficients are needed.
import time

REG_CHIP_ID = 0x01     # 0x50 on BMP580 (and BMP581), 0x51 on BMP585
REG_INT_CONFIG = 0x14  # bit0 int_mode (1 latched), bit1 int_pol, bit2 int_od, bit3 int_en, bits7:4 pad_int_drv
REG_INT_SOURCE = 0x15  # bit0 drdy_data_reg_en
REG_TEMP_XLSB = 0x1D   # 0x1D..0x1F temperature (signed 24-bit, LSB first), 0x20..0x22 pressure
REG_INT_STATUS = 0x27  # clear-on-read: bit0 drdy_data_reg, bit4 por
REG_STATUS = 0x28      # bit1 status_nvm_rdy, bit2 status_nvm_err
REG_OSR_CONFIG = 0x36  # bits2:0 osr_t, bits5:3 osr_p, bit6 press_en
REG_ODR_CONFIG = 0x37  # bits1:0 pwr_mode (0 standby, 1 normal, 2 forced, 3 continuous), bits6:2 odr, bit7 deep_dis
REG_CMD = 0x7E         # 0xB6 = soft reset

CHIP_IDS = (0x50, 0x51)

# Table 4 nominal conversion times in ms (index = OSR code 0..7 for x1..x128), +5 % tolerance.
_TCONV_P = (1.0, 1.7, 2.9, 5.4, 10.4, 20.4, 40.4, 80.4)
_TCONV_T = (1.0, 1.1, 1.5, 2.1, 3.3, 5.8, 10.8, 20.8)


class BMP580:
    def __init__(self, i2c, addr=0x47, osr_p=4, osr_t=0):
        """addr 0x47 (SDO high, Adafruit default) or 0x46 (SDO to GND / addr jumper closed).
        osr codes 0..7 = x1, x2, x4, x8, x16, x32, x64, x128 (OSR_CONFIG)."""
        self.i2c = i2c
        self.addr = addr
        self.osr_p = osr_p & 0x07
        self.osr_t = osr_t & 0x07
        time.sleep_ms(3)  # t_powup (2 ms max)
        cid = self._r(REG_CHIP_ID, 1)[0]
        if cid not in CHIP_IDS:
            raise OSError("BMP580 not found at 0x%02X (chip id 0x%02X, expected 0x50)" % (addr, cid))
        self.reset()
        # Standby with deep standby disabled (deep_dis = 1), keeping the reset ODR bits.
        odr = self._r(REG_ODR_CONFIG, 1)[0]
        self._odr_bits = (odr & 0x7C) | 0x80
        self._w(REG_ODR_CONFIG, self._odr_bits)
        time.sleep_us(2500)  # t_standby
        # INT pin: enabled, latched, active high, push-pull; keep the pad drive strength bits.
        icfg = self._r(REG_INT_CONFIG, 1)[0]
        self._w(REG_INT_CONFIG, (icfg & 0xF0) | 0x0B)
        # Data-ready source so INT_STATUS.drdy_data_reg reports finished conversions.
        self._w(REG_INT_SOURCE, 0x01)
        # Pressure enabled with the chosen oversampling (written in standby, sec. 4.3.8).
        self._w(REG_OSR_CONFIG, 0x40 | (self.osr_p << 3) | self.osr_t)

    def _r(self, reg, n):
        return self.i2c.readfrom_mem(self.addr, reg, n)

    def _w(self, reg, val):
        self.i2c.writeto_mem(self.addr, reg, bytes([val & 0xFF]))

    def reset(self):
        """Soft reset (0xB6 to CMD), then the post-power-up checks of sec. 4.3.9."""
        self._w(REG_CMD, 0xB6)
        time.sleep_ms(3)  # t_soft_res (2 ms)
        if self._r(REG_CHIP_ID, 1)[0] == 0:
            raise OSError("BMP580 chip id reads 0 after reset")
        st = self._r(REG_STATUS, 1)[0]
        if not (st & 0x02) or (st & 0x04):
            raise OSError("BMP580 NVM not ready or NVM error (STATUS 0x%02X)" % st)
        if not (self._r(REG_INT_STATUS, 1)[0] & 0x10):
            raise OSError("BMP580 soft reset did not complete (INT_STATUS.por not set)")

    def _measure(self):
        self._r(REG_INT_STATUS, 1)  # clear any stale status (clear-on-read)
        self._w(REG_ODR_CONFIG, self._odr_bits | 0x02)  # FORCED: one measurement, then back to standby
        t_ms = (_TCONV_P[self.osr_p] + _TCONV_T[self.osr_t]) * 1.05
        time.sleep_ms(int(t_ms) + 2)
        for _ in range(50):
            if self._r(REG_INT_STATUS, 1)[0] & 0x01:  # drdy_data_reg
                break
            time.sleep_ms(2)
        else:
            raise OSError("BMP580 measurement timed out")
        d = self._r(REG_TEMP_XLSB, 6)  # one burst read for data shadowing (sec. 4.5.1)
        raw_t = d[0] | (d[1] << 8) | (d[2] << 16)
        if raw_t & 0x800000:
            raw_t -= 1 << 24  # temperature is signed 24-bit
        raw_p = d[3] | (d[4] << 8) | (d[5] << 16)
        return raw_t, raw_p

    def read(self):
        """Returns (temperature degC, pressure Pa)."""
        raw_t, raw_p = self._measure()
        return raw_t / 65536.0, raw_p / 64.0

    def temperature(self):
        return self.read()[0]

    def pressure(self):
        return self.read()[1]

    def altitude(self, sea_level_pa=101325.0):
        """Approximate altitude in metres from the international barometric formula."""
        p = self.read()[1]
        return 44330.0 * (1.0 - (p / sea_level_pa) ** (1 / 5.255))

example.code:
from machine import I2C, Pin
import time
from bmp580 import BMP580

i2c = I2C({I2C_ID}, sda=Pin({SDA}), scl=Pin({SCL}))
sensor = BMP580(i2c, addr=0x47)
while True:
    t, p = sensor.read()
    print('T=%.2fC P=%.2fPa' % (t, p))
    time.sleep(1)
